exchanges: evening! cricket season starts sunday and im way too excited
Good evening! Do you play or mostly follow it?
both, i play for a club in the 2nd XI and watch everything else lol
Best of both worlds. What's your role in the team?
opening bowler. our captain arjun says im the fastest on the team but thats not saying much
Still, being the fastest is a nice title to hold.
he turns up to training on this ancient vespa thats louder than my car
Classic scooter energy. Everyone hears him coming.
lmao exactly. so the big plan is me and my mate leo are going to melbourne for the boxing day test
That's a bucket-list match, the MCG on Boxing Day is huge.
ya ive wanted to go since i was a kid. leo is moving to perth next year for work so this is kind of our last big trip before that
That makes it extra special. Perth is far, but you'll have this trip to remember.
true. hes an engineer, something with mining, so he goes wherever the projects are
Mining projects do keep people moving around Australia.
my wifes brother is also called arjun, which is confusing at family dinners, and he just bought a tesla and wont shut up about it
Two Arjuns and a new Tesla, that's a lot of conversation at one table.
he keeps showing me the fart noise feature
Very serious technology.
ok so where should we stay in melbourne. zainab said st kilda
St Kilda has the beach and a lively strip, and it's a tram ride to the MCG.
zainab lived there for a year on a working holiday so she knows it well. she worked in a cafe near acland street
Local knowledge is great. Ask her for a coffee recommendation, Melbourne takes it seriously.
lol she will have strong opinions
I'd expect nothing less.
ok and callum, another mate from the club, says we should also go see the tennis if its on
The Australian Open starts in January, so it won't overlap with Boxing Day unless you stay a few weeks.
ah no we fly back on the 30th
Then cricket gets your full attention.
callum is our keeper and works as a physio so he tapes everyones ankles before games
Handy to have someone like that on the team.
very. ok so random correction leo isnt moving to perth its adelaide, i just checked our group chat and i had it totally wrong
Adelaide is a bit closer at least, and it has a beautiful cricket ground too.
the adelaide oval yes. maybe ill visit him for a test there one day
That would be a great excuse for a second trip.
ok what do i need to know about the mcg on boxing day, is it insane crowds
Very big crowds, often over 80,000. Get there early and use the trains or trams.
do we need to book tickets now
Yes, Boxing Day sells out, so book as soon as you can.
leo is on it, hes the organised one
Good, one less thing for you.
my wife is coming for the second week, shes not into cricket but she loves wine so were doing the yarra valley
The Yarra Valley is lovely and easy to reach from Melbourne.
shes a sommelier so shell be insufferable lol
Touring wineries with a professional is either the best trip or the most educational one.
both lol
Sounds about right.
back to cricket my bowling has been off, i keep overstepping
Mark out your run-up again and practise it with a cone at the start. Overstepping is usually a rhythm problem.
ya my run up feels inconsistent since i changed boots
New boots can change your stride slightly. Give it a few sessions to settle.
i went from my old adidas ones to these kookaburra spikes, maybe thats it
That could be it. Any new pair needs a few sessions before your stride feels normal again.

questions.message: whats my brother in laws new car
what does callum do outside of cricket
leos off to adelaide next year isnt he
what brand am i wearing on my feet now
whats arjun the captain do for a living
might go to the nets tomorrow and just work on my run up for an hour
